payload.recallText: I grew up in Rhode Island not far from the Kennedys. One Thanksgiving I was at my grandma's house and we were talking about the JFK assassination. My parents got married in Newport and we would vacation there and go to the beach. We would get on a boat with our cousins and as we leave our aunt says to us to give our best to our grandmother. Our punishment was having to stay on the beach for the rest of our vacation.
